findings.evidence: 2011-11 has the largest complete-month gross merchandise sales: GBP 1,457,745.53, across 2,751 sales invoices.
findings.action: Investigate product/country mix and operational capacity before using this month as a stock-planning benchmark.
findings.limitation: One observed annual cycle cannot establish seasonality, promotion effectiveness, stock shortages or the cause of the peak.

findings.evidence: Product 23166 has the largest cancellation exposure: GBP 77,479.64; gross sales are GBP 81,448.21. Its same-window cancellation-to-sales ratio is 95.1%.
findings.action: Review invoice/cancellation records and fulfilment history before deciding whether a process investigation is warranted.
findings.limitation: Credits are not matched to original sales and may relate to earlier purchases. This is not a verified return rate or recoverable-savings estimate.

findings.evidence: 2,742 of 4,293 identified purchasers bought on at least two distinct invoices (63.9%). Identified customers cover 85.4% of gross sales. The top 10 identified customer groups contribute 16.7% of identified-customer gross sales.
findings.action: Check customer-ID coverage and concentration before proposing a retention pilot; define a control group and predeclared outcome before measuring an intervention.
findings.limitation: Within-window repeat purchasing is not lifetime retention. Missing IDs are excluded from customer denominators. No intervention or commercial uplift has been measured.
